description: Check what happened to a job from print_to_printer. States: Pending (waiting for the PrintHub computer), Dispatched (printing), Succeeded (sent to the printer), Failed, Cancelled, Expired (no PrintHub computer took it, nothing printed). JOB_NOT_FOUND means this account never had that job; JOB_EXPIRED_FROM_HISTORY means it finished and its details were removed after about seven days.
